description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes electricity consumption for its public-lighting system from March 2018 to March 2019, expressed in kWh. The national and Puglia listings share the exact municipal dataset GUID and the same CSV and spreadsheet distribution URLs, establishing that they describe one resource. The distributions are alternate representations and must not be counted twice. The source does not define meter-level geometry, temporal sampling within the stated period, circuit topology, lamp capacity or detailed schema. Coverage is the municipal lighting service in Lecce, Italy. The regional publisher is the municipality; the national portal records Regione Puglia as the harvesting source. Native metadata declares the CC BY 4.0 licence. Metadata are public, but later file-use costs and present completeness remain unverified. No specific simulation application is established, so the earlier capacity-planning label is removed. Related records describe the national catalogue and a separate Lecce lighting-consumption series for 2006–2012; continuity of definitions between periods is not established. No energy values or file bodies were read.
